findings.title: Loan design evidence still satisfies unrelated atomic stages and escalated profiles
findings.repro: loan-as-atomic-prerequisites uses the author's overlay_supported_prereq: copy original loan binding/freeze/review/acceptance references into atomic-prepare and atomic-accept, alter campaign stage/owner and stage profile/hash labels. entryEligible=true and allow=true, no missing evidence. loan-as-finalized-prerequisites changes both stage/campaign acceptedProfile labels to finalized-financial-settlement and still passes. Evidence files remain unchanged.
findings.anchor: The authenticated binding explicitly says stage=rp01-mc02. Its scope excludes native proving/public operations/corpus acceptance. Original review.scope is RP01-MC02 specified design consistency only and excludes Preview financial milestones. Acceptance.status is complete-design-subset-only. None establishes atomic-prepare or atomic-accept completion, much less finalized settlement. Hash-verified binding input experiments/moriarty-language/spec/bounds.json (b548641a1a9d74bab68ba699ffb1e2350fa0889d61b8704e98216f9d4a6c3664) has schemaVersion=moriarty-bounds/1 and semanticProfile=moriarty-bounded-atomic/1.
findings.cause: Recursive traversal now reads actual files, but _verify_binding never compares its stage against the requested prerequisite; profile agreement is only between mutable stage/campaign labels. _apply_review matches campaign scope without checking that this scope supports the prerequisite stage/profile. The supplied positive prerequisite fixture therefore demonstrates cross-stage evidence reuse rather than a genuine supported prerequisite.
findings.requiredFix: For the existing supported family require binding.stage == campaign.stage == required stage.id. Bind accepted profile and required acceptance scope to the actual supported review/acceptance meaning; unsupported mappings remain named unavailable. Preserve genuine loan design acceptance for rp01-mc02 and do not relabel it as atomic preparation/acceptance. Keep recursion and cycle handling. Replace the false positive fixture with an actually matching supported stage/candidate family. For this supported family derive acceptedProfile from that verified bounds.semanticProfile, rather than mutable label agreement.

Separate retained probes add allSprintsAccepted/nativeProofsAccepted fields or replace all closureTask strings with all obligations closed; both pass with original candidate hash unchanged.
findings.cause: _publication_core removes the entire acceptance object and all closureTask strings. The validator checks only acceptance candidateManifest/review, and closureTask string type. It does not close nested acceptance fields or bind scope, network status and closure wording to the authenticated original plus the actual design-only acceptance. Mutable publication digest alone blesses these semantic changes.
findings.requiredFix: Validate the concrete existing transformation, including a closed acceptance shape and review scope, evidence references and explicit non-execution/network limits. Restrict closure edits to the demonstrated pending-review replacement while preserving the remainder of each frozen sentence. Reject extra/dropped fields and broader approval claims. The inspected authentic archive and genuine positive loan case support this without inventing a signed approval service.
